resources.string: The phone handed over the Medtrum patch session. Tap to read the patch status.
No patch session on the watch. On the phone, open the Medtrum page and tap Move patch session to watch.

string.comment: %1$s=pump state, for example Active; %2$.1f=units left; %3$.2f=battery volts; %4$.2f=basal rate in U/h; %5$s=basal type, for example STANDARD; %6$d=seconds the patch clock is off

resources.string:
